name: Governor of Poker
description:
Distribution of this software ended at 10:00 on Wednesday, June 23, 2021.

----------------------------------------------
This is a poker game set in Texas, USA, which has a western atmosphere. You can enjoy the story of how you can become the ruler of a town by winning the poker tournament held in the town, and the charm of card games.
Once you have acquired all 13 towns in total, you can challenge yourself to become the "governor" who controls all of Texas.

There is a ``Quick Game Mode'' that you can enjoy in your spare time, and a ``Story Mode'' where you travel from town to town and win wealth and honor. Online rankings allow you to compete for points with players from all over the world.
Make the most of your poker skills, keep a poker face, and aim to become the Governor of Poker!
